description: Eval scenarios for gsd-security — security specialist agent. All graders are code-based in v3.0.

scenarios.input_description: Given a SAST scan task, verify the agent file contains the Semgrep tool reference with correct invocation flags.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies Semgrep as the SAST tool and includes the exact CLI command with --config auto and --json flags.

scenarios.input_description: Given a secret scan task, verify the agent file contains the Gitleaks tool reference with its scan mode rules.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies Gitleaks as the secrets detection tool and includes the run mode rules (full history on first invocation, staged on subsequent).

scenarios.input_description: Given a dependency audit task, verify the agent file contains both npm audit and pip-audit rules.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation references npm audit as always-available and pip-audit as optional, with block rule for critical/high vulnerabilities.

scenarios.input_description: Given a supply chain review, verify the agent file contains the 7-day waiting period rule for new packages.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies that packages published less than 7 days ago should not be adopted without explicit user approval.

grading_criteria.pattern_to_grep: packages published less than 7 days ago

scenarios.input_description: Given a container scan task, verify the agent file contains the Trivy tool reference for container image scanning.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent documentation specifies Trivy as the container scanning tool with the correct JSON output format flag.
